newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-EX-BRITISH OPEN CHAMPION CHARGED WITH DRUG SMUGGLING.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-EX-BRITISH OPEN CHAMPION CHARGED WITH DRUG SMUGGLING.

text.p: South-African born snooker player Silvino Francisco was remanded in custody on Thursday charged with smuggling 47 kg of cannabis resin into Britain, customs officers said.
They said the drug, with a street value of around 150,000 pounds ($250,000), was found in Francisco's car as he arrived at the southern port of Dover from France on Monday.
Francisco, who lives in England, won the British Open in 1985 and was once ranked in the world's top 10.
He still plays professionally and beat world number one Stephen Hendry in a minor tournament in Thailand last September.
